meaning:
αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Isa.59:9 (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12:9 * ;]
1. brightness
2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: Act.20:11 (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)

elsewhere.note: When he had gone up, and had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
